verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's GitHub README documents an official optimized Docker image that bundles a FastAPI server for deployment. A self-hosting docs section and a real-time monitoring dashboard with browser-pool visibility point to production-oriented server operation. Community feedback that newcomers struggle with production configuration is general difficulty, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed first-party production deployment guidance (scaling, configuration, security/auth) and independent hands-on corroboration of the official image in production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use
